```

title: [Core] Remove busy loop from idle buffer readers
body_opening:
## Purpose

IBM bundles vLLM with SystemZ mainframes, and in these systems:
1. The CPU cores are _extremely_ expensive
2. The systems are shared across many tenants (think multiple host operating systems and many VMs running on each) so it is important to not use any cpu cycles while not doing work.

This makes the fix from #16226 unacceptable for our customers, so this PR is a similar alternative to #24618 that completely removes the need for a busy loop at idle in the shared memory buffer readers.
